parameters.query:
SELECT 
    d.router_id,
    d.usage_date,
    d.wan1_total_mb,
    d.wan1_total_gb,
    d.wan2_total_mb,
    d.wan2_total_gb,
    d.grand_total_mb,
    d.grand_total_gb,
    d.readings_count,
    (
        SELECT json_agg(q.*)
        FROM view_mikrotik_wan_quota_status q
        WHERE q.router_id = d.router_id
    ) AS quota_info
FROM view_mikrotik_wan_daily_usage d
WHERE d.usage_date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO wan_incident_state (
    router_id,
    interface_name,
    is_down,
    outage_started_at,
    last_alert_sent_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    (CASE WHEN $3 = 'DOWN' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END),
    (CASE WHEN $3 = 'DOWN' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (router_id, interface_name)
DO UPDATE SET
    is_down = EXCLUDED.is_down,
    outage_started_at = (CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_down THEN COALESCE(wan_incident_state.outage_started_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END),
    last_alert_sent_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW();

SELECT
    id,
    router_id,
    uptime,
    wan1_rx,
    wan1_tx,
    wan2_rx,
    wan2_tx,
    received_at
FROM mikrotik_wan_readings
WHERE router_id = $1
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO mikrotik_wan_readings (
    router_id,
    uptime,
    wan1_rx,
    wan1_tx,
    wan2_rx,
    wan2_tx,
    received_at
)
VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO mikrotik_wan_usage (
    router_id,
    reading_id,
    wan1_rx_bytes,
    wan1_tx_bytes,
    wan2_rx_bytes,
    wan2_tx_bytes,
    total_bytes,
    counter_reset,
    usage_at
)
VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9
);

parameters.query:
WITH recent_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        (wan1_rx_bytes + wan1_tx_bytes) AS wan1_bytes,
        (wan2_rx_bytes + wan2_tx_bytes) AS wan2_bytes
    FROM mikrotik_wan_usage
    WHERE router_id = $1
    ORDER BY usage_at DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(wan1_bytes) AS sum_wan1,
        SUM(wan2_bytes) AS sum_wan2,
        COUNT(*) AS total_samples
    FROM recent_stats
)
SELECT 
    a.sum_wan1,
    a.sum_wan2,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.total_samples >= 3 AND a.sum_wan1 = 0 AND a.sum_wan2 > 100000 THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
    END AS wan1_suspected_down,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.total_samples >= 3 AND a.sum_wan2 = 0 AND a.sum_wan1 > 100000 THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
    END AS wan2_suspected_down,
    s1.is_down AS wan1_currently_down,
    s1.outage_started_at AS wan1_outage_started_at,
    s2.is_down AS wan2_currently_down,
    s2.outage_started_at AS wan2_outage_started_at,
    q1.landline_number AS wan1_landline,
    q1.account_holder AS wan1_holder,
    q1.support_email AS wan1_email,
    q2.landline_number AS wan2_landline,
    q2.account_holder AS wan2_holder,
    q2.support_email AS wan2_email
FROM aggregates a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT is_down, outage_started_at FROM wan_incident_state WHERE router_id = $1 AND interface_name = 'wan1') s1
CROSS JOIN (SELECT is_down, outage_started_at FROM wan_incident_state WHERE router_id = $1 AND interface_name = 'wan2') s2
CROSS JOIN (SELECT landline_number, account_holder, support_email FROM mikrotik_wan_quotas WHERE router_id = $1 AND interface_name = 'wan1') q1
CROSS JOIN (SELECT landline_number, account_holder, support_email FROM mikrotik_wan_quotas WHERE router_id = $1 AND interface_name = 'wan2') q2;

WITH current_status AS (
    SELECT 
        q.router_id,
        q.interface_name,
        q.provider_name,
        q.quota_gb,
        q.used_gb,
        q.remaining_gb,
        q.used_percentage,
        q.days_left,
        q.renewal_date,
        q.cycle_start,
        COALESCE(s.alerted_80, FALSE) AS alerted_80,
        COALESCE(s.alerted_95, FALSE) AS alerted_95,
        COALESCE(s.alerted_100, FALSE) AS alerted_100
    FROM view_mikrotik_wan_quota_status q
    LEFT JOIN quota_alert_state s 
        ON q.router_id = s.router_id 
       AND q.interface_name = s.interface_name 
       AND q.cycle_start = s.cycle_start
)
SELECT 
    router_id,
    interface_name,
    provider_name,
    quota_gb,
    used_gb,
    remaining_gb,
    used_percentage,
    days_left,
    renewal_date,
    cycle_start,
    CASE 
        WHEN used_percentage >= 99.0 AND NOT alerted_100 THEN '100'
        WHEN used_percentage >= 95.0 AND NOT alerted_95 THEN '95'
        WHEN used_percentage >= 80.0 AND NOT alerted_80 THEN '80'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS triggered_tier
FROM current_status
WHERE 
    (used_percentage >= 99.0 AND NOT alerted_100)
    OR
    (used_percentage >= 95.0 AND NOT alerted_95 AND used_percentage < 99.0)
    OR 
    (used_percentage >= 80.0 AND NOT alerted_80 AND used_percentage < 95.0);

INSERT INTO quota_alert_state (
    router_id, 
    interface_name, 
    cycle_start, 
    alerted_80, 
    alerted_95, 
    alerted_100,
    last_alert_at
)
VALUES (
    $1, 
    $2, 
    $3::date, 
    ($4 = '80' OR $4 = '95' OR $4 = '100'), 
    ($4 = '95' OR $4 = '100'), 
    ($4 = '100'),
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (router_id, interface_name, cycle_start)
DO UPDATE SET 
    alerted_80 = (CASE WHEN $4 IN ('80', '95', '100') THEN TRUE ELSE quota_alert_state.alerted_80 END),
    alerted_95 = (CASE WHEN $4 IN ('95', '100') THEN TRUE ELSE quota_alert_state.alerted_95 END),
    alerted_100 = (CASE WHEN $4 = '100' THEN TRUE ELSE quota_alert_state.alerted_100 END),
    last_alert_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO wan_outage_events (
    router_id,
    interface_name,
    provider_name,
    landline_number,
    account_holder,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    duration_minutes,
    outage_cause,
    email_sent,
    email_sent_at,
    email_recipient,
    email_subject,
    email_body
)
VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'ISP_FAILURE', TRUE, NOW(), $9, $10, $11
);
